desarrollo.ayuda: Choose which identity to browse the application with. It replaces permissions and business identity; authentication is still Okta's.

prohibido.descripcion: Your account has no permissions in this application. If you think this is a mistake, contact the administrator.

errores.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action
errores.not_found: We could not find what you are looking for
errores.invalid_state: This operation does not apply right now
errores.already_in_queue: You are already in line for this vehicle
errores.lote_no_disponible: The vehicle has already been awarded
errores.adjudicacion_activa: You already have a vehicle awarded
errores.conflicto_concurrencia: Someone else acted at the same time; please try again
errores.dependencia_no_disponible: A service is not responding; please try later

tiposDeEvento.VEHICULO_INCLUIDO: Vehicle added to the sale announcement
tiposDeEvento.VEHICULO_RETIRADO_DE_CONVOCATORIA: Vehicle removed from the sale announcement

vehiculos.soloLectura: This vehicle cannot be edited in its current status.
vehiculos.motivoRetiroAyuda: It is recorded in the audit log. It is required.
vehiculos.identificadorAyuda: Stored in uppercase and cannot be repeated.

fotografias.noSePuedeEliminarUltima: The only photograph cannot be deleted.
fotografias.formatosAdmitidos: JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 10 MB.

validacionVehiculo.no_es_entero: It must be a whole number
validacionVehiculo.fuera_de_rango: The value is outside the allowed range
validacionVehiculo.tipo_no_admitido: Only JPG, PNG or WEBP images are allowed
validacionVehiculo.es_la_ultima: The only photograph cannot be deleted
validacionVehiculo.no_es_permutacion: The received order does not match the gallery
validacionVehiculo.demasiados_cambios: Too many order changes at once
validacionVehiculo.caracter_no_permitido: Only letters, digits and the signs - _ / are allowed
validacionVehiculo.duplicado: Another vehicle already has this value

convocatorias.descripcion: Groups of vehicles offered for sale.
convocatorias.sinResultados: There are no sale announcements with this status.
convocatorias.soloLectura: This sale announcement can no longer be edited in its current status.
convocatorias.folioAyuda: Stored in uppercase and cannot be repeated.
convocatorias.nombreAyuda: How it is recognized in lists and in the audit log. It may be repeated.
convocatorias.horasLiquidacionAyuda: Calendar hours from the award, not business days.
convocatorias.sinLotes: No vehicles have been included yet.
convocatorias.sinDisponibles: There are no available vehicles to include.
convocatorias.incluido: Vehicle included in the sale announcement.
convocatorias.retiradoDeConvocatoria: Vehicle removed from the sale announcement.
convocatorias.motivoRetiroLoteAyuda: It is recorded in the audit log. It is required.
convocatorias.loteConFila: It cannot be removed: participants are already queued.
convocatorias.enOtraConvocatoria: That vehicle joined another active sale announcement. Refresh the list and choose a different one.

validacionConvocatoria.no_es_entero: It must be a whole number
validacionConvocatoria.fuera_de_rango: The value is outside the allowed range
validacionConvocatoria.orden_de_fechas: The dates must run in order: publication, sale start, sale end
validacionConvocatoria.sin_lotes: Add at least one vehicle before sending it for approval
validacionConvocatoria.etiqueta_no_admitida: The text formatting contains elements that are not allowed
validacionConvocatoria.enlace_no_admitido: A link points to an address that is not allowed
validacionConvocatoria.caracter_no_permitido: Only letters, digits and the signs - _ / are allowed
validacionConvocatoria.duplicado: Another sale announcement already has this reference number

acciones.sinAcciones: There are no actions available in this status.
acciones.motivoAyuda: It is recorded in the audit log. It is required.
acciones.confirmar_ENVIAR_A_APROBACION: Once sent for approval it can no longer be edited until someone rules on it. Continue?
acciones.confirmar_APROBAR: Approve this sale announcement? It will be ready to publish.
acciones.confirmar_PUBLICAR: Once published it becomes visible to participants as soon as its publication date arrives. Continue?
acciones.confirmar_CONCLUIR: Closing is final: unsold vehicles return to the catalog and there is no way back. Continue?
acciones.confirmar_RECHAZAR: The campaign returns to draft so it can be corrected. State why it is being rejected.
acciones.confirmar_OCULTAR: It stops being visible, and can only be recovered as a draft. State why it is being hidden.
acciones.hecho_RECHAZAR: Sale announcement rejected; it went back to draft.
acciones.hecho_REACTIVAR: Sale announcement reactivated; it went back to draft.
acciones.noApruebasLoTuyo: You cannot approve a sale announcement that you created.

aprobaciones.sinPendientes: There are no sale announcements awaiting a decision.

catalogo.descripcion: Fleet vehicles available for you to buy.
catalogo.sinResultados: There are no sale announcements available right now.
catalogo.explicacionSinAbrir: The sale announcement is published, but the sale has not opened yet: you can review the vehicles and their technical sheets, and get in line once the start date arrives.
catalogo.explicacionAbierta: You can get in line for any vehicle. Whoever is first in line is awarded the vehicle and receives the notice to settle the payment.
catalogo.explicacionCerrada: The sale is over and no further requests are accepted. If you were in line and a vehicle was awarded to you, your deadline to settle the payment is still running.

fila.confirmarCancelacion: Canceling gives up your turn. Joining again will give you a new one, at the end of the line. Continue?
fila.confirmarCancelacionAdjudicada: If you cancel, the vehicle goes to the next participant in line and you cannot get it back. Continue?
fila.ventaCerrada: The sale for this announcement has closed.
fila.noDisponible: This vehicle is no longer available.
fila.vendidoAOtro: This vehicle was sold to another participant.
fila.congelada: You have an active award on another vehicle. Your place here is held with your original turn.
fila.adjudicada: The vehicle is yours. Payment is still pending.
fila.canceladaPorVencimiento: Your award was canceled because the payment deadline passed.
fila.noAdjudicada: The sale closed before your turn came up.
fila.formatosComprobante: JPG, PNG or PDF, up to 10 MB.
fila.avisoRevisionComprobante: This file will be reviewed by treasury.

filaAdministrativa.descripcion: Queue aggregates. The application does not show who is queued or in what order.
filaAdministrativa.sinIdentidades: Per-participant detail is reserved for auditing.

tesoreria.descripcion: Requests with an uploaded receipt, pending a decision.
tesoreria.sinPendientes: There are no receipts pending verification.
tesoreria.yaResuelta: This request has already been resolved.
tesoreria.motivoRechazoAyuda: Required to reject. It is recorded in the audit log.
tesoreria.confirmarAvalar: The vehicle will be marked as sold and the action cannot be undone. Continue?
tesoreria.confirmarRechazar: The vehicle will be automatically awarded to the next participant in line. Continue?
tesoreria.hechoAvalar: Payment approved. The vehicle was marked as sold.
tesoreria.hechoRechazar: Payment rejected. The lot was reassigned to the next participant in line.

auditoria.promptInicial: Choose a record type and its identifier to see its audit log.
auditoria.sinEventos: There are no events matching these filters.
auditoria.avisoExportacion: The export itself is recorded in the audit log.
auditoria.descripcionReconstruccion: Every request in the lot, in turn order. Unlike the administrative screens, identities are shown here.
auditoria.sinSolicitudes: This lot has no request on record.
auditoria.descripcionVerificacion: Recomputed from the audit log, not from what the application believes happened.
auditoria.turnosInconsistentes: Turns with an inconsistent expiration date
auditoria.turnosSinExplicar: Turns with no event explaining their current status

busqueda.rango_invalido: Check the dates: the range is not valid.
busqueda.rango_excedido: The range cannot exceed 31 days unless you choose an identifier.
busqueda.sin_criterio: Choose at least an identifier, an event type or a participant.

auditoria.truncada: There are more events than a single query can return. Narrow the date range.
auditoria.anterioresAlRango: This record has events before the range.
